race.comment: TRUE REBEL (2) was too strong beating Meness at Geelong as favourite before getting a mile back at Caulfield behind a very well-rated leader and rattling home to just miss. Was unsuited staying down in trip there and now gets to 2040m from a soft gate. He's close enough to Derby favourite and can justify that with victory here. JOELY (11) looks a filly suited up in trip. She's been good from hopeless spots her past two behind Saintly Dancer who won the Thousand Guineas last week. She'll be charging late. Not giving up on SKUA (4) who just did way too much wrong on a very slow speed last week in the G3 Caulfield Classic. If he gets his manners right he can improve out of sight. SALANN (10) got home well in the Thousand Guineas at 100/1 and looks back on track, respecting. LEPOLO (1) was solid in the Caulfield Classic, unsuited back in the field there. He can improve.
